theorem infimum_normal_subgroups {G : Type*} [Group G] (I : Type*)

  Normal (⨅ (i : I), H i) := by
  have hkey : ∀ n ∈ (⨅ i, H i), ∀ g : G, g * n * g⁻¹ ∈ (⨅ i, H i) := by
    intro n hn g

    have hi := hH i
    first
      | exact hi.conj_mem n hn_i g
      | exact hi n hn_i g
  first
    | exact ⟨hkey⟩
    | exact hkey
    | constructor
      intro n hn g
      exact hkey n hn g
